space.expression: Exponential-size linearization; no numerical space coefficient extracted.

notes: Subexponential only in the stated small-error regime. Date is the checked ECCC revision, preceding ICALP 2011.

extra.parameters: Prime q=q(n) with q ≫ (αq log n)²; αq=n^ε, fixed 0≤ε<1/2.
extra.noise: Source Gaussian Ψ_α over GF(q), width parameter αq.
extra.samples: Oracle access; 2^{Õ(n^{2ε})} samples allowed, not a linear-sample claim.
extra.model: Classical randomized polynomial-system linearization; polynomial input-size factors implicit.
extra.assumptions: Theorem for the specified Gaussian distribution and modulus regime.
extra.success: High probability as in Theorems 3.1 and 3.3.
